Resolved via CEP-45 flags mechanism (not build-string encoding): variants now first-class matchable; build stays = hash, filenames unchanged. See spaxi-9km.

Implemented: multi-valued variants now emit per-value membership flags + atomic <variant>_set:<lexically-sorted,deduped,joined> flag; FlagCollisionError guard for reserved hash/_set keys; unit tests (sorting, dedup, singleton, empty, scalar/bool, collisions) + e2e _set subset-vs-superset selection. 44 tests pass.
conda command now catches AmbiguousSpecError and prints 'spack find -lv <spec>' (hashes + variants); tests added
Added spaxi.log.setup_logging, -l/--log-sink and -L/--log-level general options, and debug logging per-package (convert.py) and before each spack subprocess (spack.py). Tests added.

conda.build_conda_package no longer raises on empty payload; builds a valid empty metapackage (empty paths.json/files, empty pkg tar) so bundle packages like glx convert and remain resolvable by dependents. Updated tests.
Implemented: asctime in log format; _human_bytes helper; debug logs around scan/archive/compress phases. Tests added, 54 pass.

Two-phase convert_spec: sequential _discover (spack calls) then ThreadPoolExecutor build pool; repodata serialized via channel.stage_package/index_record + Lock. Added -j/--jobs (0=CPUs) and -z/--compression-level (1-22, default 19). 59 tests pass incl. parallel==serial equivalence.

build_conda_package returns BuildResult(path, prefix_limit); limit set only when binary files embed the prefix. Converted carries prefix_limit; CLI drops per-line note and prints one channel-wide summary ('at most N characters, tightest: X'). Fixed off-by-one (<= not <). 60 tests pass.

Implemented pure-Python ELF RPATH/RUNPATH -> $ORIGIN rewriter (spaxi.relocate); wired through scan_prefix/build_conda_package/convert_spec with full-closure prefix set; --origin-rpaths default on. Verified on real spack binaries via readelf: libzstd.so RPATH -> $ORIGIN, bin/zstd -> $ORIGIN/../lib with no absolute store paths, exec bit preserved. 69 tests pass.

Implemented relocate.unify_prefix_refs: folds every closure-prefix reference onto one common placeholder (shortest referenced); binary length-preserving via NUL-segment shrink, text free. Wired into scan_prefix after the $ORIGIN pass with a common-root gate; records folded placeholder + feeds length limit. Verified on real tar binary (rmt + pigz/bzip2/xz/zstd all map to <env>/..., ELF valid). 76 tests pass.

Memoized resolve_one and prefix by hash in _discover (shared deps resolved once); added deterministic (len,str) tie-break for the unified placeholder for reproducible builds. Unit test proves shared-dep resolved once; determinism verified across PYTHONHASHSEED. 77 tests pass.

Parallelized scan_prefix per-file loop via separate capped file pool; single-pass anchored prefix detection; phase timing logs. Benchmarked ~2x on large-file scan (saturates ~4-8, hence cap). 80 tests pass incl. executor==serial equivalence.
Added conda.ZstdThreadBudget(J); payload-proportional zstd thread requests with floor 1; reverted scan to per-package serial. Benchmarked 400MB level-19: 58.8->16.1(4)->11.7s(16). 81 tests pass.

Added Spack.dag_nodes/dag_prefixes (spack find -d, one call each); _discover builds node+prefix maps from them with per-node fallback. Constant 3 spack calls regardless of tree size. 82 tests pass incl. batch + fallback unit tests.
